correctness.rationale: The tetrahedral mask symmetry splits pure harmonic degree 3 into orthogonal irreducible sectors A=xyz, B=xi(5xi²-3), C=xi(xj²-xk²), dimensions 1+3+3. Averaging squared generators over each cap and dividing by full-sphere norms 1/105,4/7,4/105 yields three exact degree-seven eigenvalue polynomials. Independently symbolic difference factorizations and trace A+3B+3C=14(1-c) hold. The sign of A-C changes at c*=sqrt((9+sqrt33)/24), which is within [1/sqrt3,1); B is lower there. This establishes the threefold-to-onefold top mode switch and fourfold exact crossing, including touching-cap boundary.
